props.description:
Every creature hit by one of Nidhogg's attacks, skills or spells (whatever damage it takes, even none) loses its Poison Resistance, Immunity and Absorption until the end of the round, or until Nidhogg falls. A Poison Vulnerability is not lost.

The action that lands the hit is not affected; only the damage that comes after it is.
props.name: Soul Master

props.animation_script:
// Tail Stab — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js

// Re-run: node tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js --out <file>

(async () => {

const CFG = {"peakMs":580,"staggerMs":200,"gateLagMs":160,"reach":100,"angle":0.3,"pixel":3,"totalTimeoutMs":10000,"sfx":[{"at":380,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_SWINGF.wav","v":0.6}],"hitSfx":[{"dt":-10,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Hit_PiercingB.ogg","v":0.75},{"dt":0,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitBlowL.ogg","v":0.5}]};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.nidhogg.tail-stab";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Tail Stab]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

function hitMap() {

try {

const d = globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.experimental?.battleDirector?.getActiveDirector?.();

const r = d?.ctx?.actionResult?.perTargetResults;

if (!Array.isArray(r) || !r.length) return null;

const o = {};

for (const x of r) if (x?.tokenUuid) o[x.tokenUuid] = x.hit !== false;

return o;

} catch (_) { return null; }

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// Tail Stab · Nidhogg (inner script, every client).

// He coils his tail back, then snaps it forward over his back (his 3D rig's tailStrike, the strike at 0.58 s); with

// the snap a bundle of his soul-green streaks drives down into the target from his side and a long star flares at

// the point with a pierce ring and sparks, under a green bloom; a little of his soul fire stays burning at the

// wound for ~0.6 s (CotM's merged soul-flame puff field: rising puffs + light, hot at the base). A missed target gets no streak and no impact sound. oni.hit per target as

// the point lands; the damage gate (fireDone) a beat after the last target.

// Pixel FX: stock pixelfx melee/thrust (vendored under pixel-entrance/pixelfx/fx/melee, recoloured, rotated to come

// down from his side), one frame per target at K screen px per effect px, the point on the target's drawn chest

// (3D camera: drawnMeshBounds). Every sound goes through oni.sfx. No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const hits = ctx.params.hits || null;

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && !t.destroyed && t.mesh);

const readyHook = ctx.params.readyHook;

const ready = () => { if (readyHook) { try { Hooks.callAll(readyHook); } catch (e) {} } };

let gated = false;

const gate = () => { if (gated) return; gated = true; oni.fireDone(); };

if (!caster || !caster.mesh || !canvas || !canvas.ready) { ready(); gate(); return; }

const route = (p) => { try { return foundry.utils.getRoute(p); } catch (e) { return "/" + p; } };

const PXD = "modules/fabula-ultima-companion/scripts/battle-director/pixel-entrance/pixelfx/";

let PX = null, FXM = null, SL = null;

try {

PX = await import(route(PXD + "core/index.js"));

FXM = await import(route(PXD + "fx/melee/thrust.js"));

SL = await import(route("modules/fabula-ultima-companion/scripts/conflict-event/soul-fx/soul-fx-lib.js"));

} catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Tail Stab] pixel fx unavailable", e); }

// ── timing (ms from the start) ──

const rigT = oni.rig.timing ? oni.rig.timing("tailStrike") : null;

const PEAK = (rigT && rigT.peakMs) || cfg.peakMs || 580;

const RIG_END = (rigT && rigT.durationMs) || 1520;

const OUT_MS = 70; // the stock thrust's point arrives 0.07 s in

const STAG = cfg.staggerMs != null ? cfg.staggerMs : 200;

const FX_MS = 750;

const LINGER = cfg.lingerMs != null ? cfg.lingerMs / 1000 : 0.6; // the soul flame keeps burning at the wound (s)

const FLAME_END = OUT_MS + 100 + LINGER * 1000 + 320; // last puff gone, ms after fxAt

const GATE_LAG = cfg.gateLagMs != null ? cfg.gateLagMs : 160;

const TG = targets.map((t, i) => {

const hitAt = PEAK + i * STAG;

return { tok: t, i, hitAt, fxAt: hitAt - OUT_MS, hit: hits ? hits[t.document.uuid] !== false : true, fx: null, done: false };

});

const LAST = TG.length ? TG[TG.length - 1].hitAt : PEAK;

const GATE = LAST + GATE_LAG;

const TOTAL = Math.max(cfg.totalMs || 0, RIG_END + 50, TG.length ? TG[TG.length - 1].fxAt + Math.max(FX_MS, FLAME_END) + 50 : 0);

if (cfg.debug) globalThis.__nidPlan = { move: "tail-stab", PEAK, GATE, TOTAL, hits: TG.map((g) => ({ name: g.tok.name, at: g.hitAt, hit: g.hit })) };

// ── space ──

const S3 = () => globalThis.__ONI_BATTLE_STAGE_3D__ || null;

let D = 1;

try { const v = globalThis.FUCompanion.api.camera.restViewFor(canvas.scene); if (v && v.scale > 0) D = v.scale; } catch (e) {}

if (!(D > 0)) D = canvas.stage.scale.x || 1;

const bodyBox = (tok) => {

try {

const s = S3(); const b = s && s.drawnMeshBounds ? s.drawnMeshBounds(tok) : tok.mesh.getBounds(false);

if (b && b.width > 0) {

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(b.x, b.y), c = inv(b.x + b.width, b.y + b.height);

return { x0: a.x, y0: a.y, w: c.x - a.x, h: c.y - a.y };

}

} catch (e) {}

return { x0: tok.x, y0: tok.y, w: tok.w, h: tok.h };

};

const cb = bodyBox(caster), casterCx = cb.x0 + cb.w / 2;

// ── layer: one frame per hit target (colour + additive light sprite), effect px = screen px x K ──

const root = new PIXI.Container(); root.name = "oni-nidhogg-tail-stab"; root.eventMode = "none"; root.scale.set(1 / D); root.zIndex = 95000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true; canvas.stage.addChild(root);

// his soul ramp (soul-fx-lib SOUL, 7 steps): white-hot at the point, soul green along the streaks

const PAL = cfg.palette || ["#0a3019", "#11522a", "#1d7d3b", "#34b04d", "#5dff6e", "#b4ffba", "#ffffff"];

const SPK = cfg.sparks || ["#dcffd2", "#a6ff9c", "#5dff6e", "#22a86c"];

const GLOW_TINT = 0x5dff6e;

const REACH = cfg.reach || 100; // the streaks' length, effect px

const ANG = cfg.angle != null ? cfg.angle : 0.3; // radians below level: down from his side into the target

const TX = 9 + REACH, TY = -20; // the stock effect's point (from its origin)

const SZ = 2 * (REACH + 44); // square frame, the point at its centre

let bloomTex = null;

const getBloomTex = () => {

if (bloomTex) return bloomTex;

const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = 128;

const c2 = cv.getContext("2d"), gr = c2.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 0, 64, 64, 64);

gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)"); gr.addColorStop(0.35, "rgba(255,255,255,0.45)"); gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");

c2.fillStyle = gr; c2.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);

return (bloomTex = PIXI.Texture.from(cv));

};

let seedR = 0x6A09E667;

const R = () => { seedR ^= seedR << 13; seedR ^= seedR >>> 17; seedR ^= seedR << 5; return ((seedR >>> 0) % 100000) / 100000; };

const rr = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

// a soul-flame puff (CotM's): rises and slows; puffField merges them, hottest where they are young and dense

const spawnPuff = (L, x, y, k) => L.push({ kind: "puff", x, y, vx: rr(-6, 6), vy: -rr(18, 42), age: 0, life: rr(0.16, 0.3) * (0.7 + 0.4 * k), s: rr(1.6, 2.8) * (0.6 + 0.5 * k), f: R() });

const stepPuffs = (L, dt) => { for (let i = L.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const q = L[i]; q.age += dt; if (q.age >= q.life) { L.splice(i, 1); continue; } q.x += q.vx * dt; q.y += q.vy * dt; q.vx *= Math.pow(0.2, dt); q.vy *= Math.pow(0.55, dt); } };

const OUT_S = OUT_MS / 1000;

const burnK = (u) => { const v = u - OUT_S; return v < 0 ? 0 : v < 0.1 ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (v - 0.1) / LINGER); };

function makeFx(g) {

const bb = bodyBox(g.tok);

const flip = casterCx > bb.x0 + bb.w / 2; // he stands to the target's right: come in from the right

const a = flip ? -ANG : ANG, fxs = flip ? -1 : 1, cs = Math.cos(a), sn = Math.sin(a);

// the origin that puts the point at the frame centre (painter: toX = x + lx*fx*cs - ly*sn, toY = y + lx*fx*sn + ly*cs)

const ox = SZ / 2 - (TX * fxs * cs - TY * sn), oy = SZ / 2 - (TX * fxs * sn + TY * cs);

const frame = PX.createFrame(SZ, SZ);

const fx = PX.createFx(FXM, { x: ox, y: oy, flip, angle: a, reach: REACH, palette: PAL, sparks: SPK, seed: 4 + g.i * 7, light: cfg.lightK || 1.3 });

const tex = (buf) => PIXI.Texture.fromBuffer(new Uint8Array(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, SZ * SZ * 4), SZ, SZ, { scaleMode: PIXI.SCALE_MODES.NEAREST, alphaMode: PIXI.ALPHA_MODES.UNPACK });

const csp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex(frame.color)), lsp = new PIXI.Sprite(tex(frame.light));

lsp.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const bl = new PIXI.Sprite(getBloomTex()); bl.anchor.set(0.5); bl.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; bl.tint = GLOW_TINT; bl.alpha = 0;

root.addChild(bl, csp, lsp);

const K = Math.max(2, Math.min(4, Math.round(cfg.pixel || 3)));

// where the soul flame burns: the wound (the frame centre) and the last few px of the streak behind it

const bx = -fxs * cs, by = -sn, src = [];

for (let d = 0; d <= 9; d += 1.5) src.push([SZ / 2 + bx * d, SZ / 2 + by * d]);

return { frame, fx, cs: csp, ls: lsp, bl, K, last: 0, puffs: [], src, fxDone: false };

}

function placeFx(g) {

const bb = bodyBox(g.tok), F = g.fx, K = F.K;

const cx = (bb.x0 + bb.w / 2) * D, cy = (bb.y0 + bb.h * 0.45) * D;

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { s.scale.set(K); s.position.set(Math.round(cx - (SZ / 2) * K), Math.round(cy - (SZ / 2) * K)); }

F.bl.position.set(cx, cy); F.bl.scale.set((K * (cfg.bloomPx || 70)) / 128);

}

function dropFx(g) {

const F = g.fx; if (!F) return;

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { try { s.parent && s.parent.removeChild(s); s.destroy({ texture: true, baseTexture: true }); } catch (e) {} }

try { F.bl.parent && F.bl.parent.removeChild(F.bl); F.bl.destroy({ texture: false }); } catch (e) {}

g.fx = null;

}

// ── the show ──

let t0 = 0, lastSim = -1, tickFn = null, nHit = 0;

const cost = { n: 0, sum: 0, max: 0 };

function tick() {

const c0 = performance.now(), el = c0 - t0;

for (const g of TG) {

if (g.done || el < g.hitAt) continue;

g.done = true;

try { oni.hit({ tokenUuid: g.tok.document.uuid, hit: g.hit }); } catch (e) {}

if (g.hit) { nHit++; try { oni.screenshake({ duration: 260, intensity: nHit === 1 ? 7 : 5 }); } catch (e) {} }

}

if (!PX || !FXM) return;

if (lastSim >= 0 && el - lastSim < 33) return;

lastSim = el;

for (const g of TG) {

if (!g.hit || el < g.fxAt) continue;

if (!g.fx && !g.gone) { try { g.fx = makeFx(g); } catch (e) { g.gone = true; console.warn("[ONI][Tail Stab] fx build failed", e); continue; } }

const F = g.fx; if (!F) continue;

const u = Math.min((el - g.fxAt) / 1000, FLAME_END / 1000 + 0.2), dts = Math.max(0, u - F.last);

if (dts > 0) { if (!F.fxDone) F.fx.update(dts); F.last = u; }

if (!F.fxDone && F.fx.done()) F.fxDone = true;

// the soul flame left burning at the wound: front-loaded at the strike, dying over LINGER

const k = burnK(u);

if (k > 0) {

const n = (u - OUT_S < 0.1 ? 3.2 : 1.6 * Math.pow(k, 1.4)) * (cfg.flameRate || 1);

for (let j = 0; j < 4; j++) if (R() < n / 4) { const q = F.src[Math.floor(R() * F.src.length)]; spawnPuff(F.puffs, q[0] + rr(-1.5, 1.5), q[1] + rr(-1.5, 1.5), k); }

}

stepPuffs(F.puffs, dts);

if (F.fxDone && k <= 0 && !F.puffs.length) { dropFx(g); g.gone = true; continue; }

PX.clearFrame(F.frame);

if (!F.fxDone) F.fx.draw(F.frame, "front");

if (SL && F.puffs.length) SL.puffField(PX.painterFor(F.frame), F.puffs, u);

// the bloom: flares green as the point lands, then breathes down with the flame

const flare = u < OUT_S ? Math.max(0, u / OUT_S) * 0.5 : Math.exp(-(u - OUT_S) / 0.2);

F.bl.alpha = (cfg.bloomAlpha || 0.55) * Math.max(flare, 0.35 * k);

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { try { s.texture.baseTexture.resource.update(); } catch (e) {} }

placeFx(g);

}

const dt = performance.now() - c0; cost.n++; cost.sum += dt; if (dt > cost.max) cost.max = dt;

if (cfg.debug) globalThis.__nidCost = { avg: +(cost.sum / cost.n).toFixed(3), max: +cost.max.toFixed(3), n: cost.n };

}

// ── run ──

const rig = oni.rig.play(caster, "tailStrike", {});

t0 = performance.now();

ready();

for (const c of cfg.sfx || []) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.6, delay: c.at || 0 }); } catch (e) {} }

for (const g of TG) {

if (!g.hit) continue;

for (const c of cfg.hitSfx || []) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.6, delay: Math.max(0, g.hitAt + (c.dt || 0)) }); } catch (e) {} }

}

const tkr = canvas.app.ticker;

tickFn = () => { try { tick(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Tail Stab] frame threw", e); } };

tkr.add(tickFn);

try {

await wait(GATE);

tick();

gate();

await wait(Math.max(0, TOTAL - GATE));

try { await Promise.race([rig.done, wait(800)]); } catch (e) {}

} finally {

try { tkr.remove(tickFn); } catch (e) {}

for (const g of TG) dropFx(g);

try { root.parent && root.parent.removeChild(root); root.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

gate();

}

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 10000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, hits: hitMap(), strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Tail Stab" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// Call of the Master · Nidhogg (inner script, every client).

// He roars; at the jaw snap a ring of his green soul fire leaves his feet and runs out

// across the whole floor, through the party. Each target it reaches flares in soul

// fire and turns green (a colour wash on its own mesh). Damage gate (fireDone) once

// the front has passed the farthest target; the ring then cools and fades past them.

// After the gate the engine tears each HIT target's soul (Soul Tithe's own show),

// which this script does not draw.

// Pixel FX: drawn on CPU frames in "field space" (effect px = world px x D, the

// scene's rest-view scale, so 1 effect px = 1 screen px at the battle view), the

// soul-fire puff field and ramps from soul-fx-lib, placed where the 3D camera draws

// the floor (projectFoot). Back half of the ring under the battlers, front half over.

// No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const hits = ctx.params.hits || null;

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const targets = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter((t) => t && !t.destroyed && t.mesh);

const readyHook = ctx.params.readyHook;

const ready = () => { if (readyHook) { try { Hooks.callAll(readyHook); } catch (e) {} } };

let gated = false;

const gate = () => { if (gated) return; gated = true; oni.fireDone(); };

if (!caster || !caster.mesh || !canvas || !canvas.ready) { ready(); gate(); return; }

const route = (p) => { try { return foundry.utils.getRoute(p); } catch (e) { return "/" + p; } };

const MOD = "modules/fabula-ultima-companion/scripts/";

let PX = null, SL = null;

try {

PX = await import(route(MOD + "battle-director/pixel-entrance/pixelfx/core/index.js"));

SL = await import(route(MOD + "conflict-event/soul-fx/soul-fx-lib.js"));

} catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Call of the Master] pixel fx unavailable", e); }

// ── timing (ms from the roar's start) ──

const HOLD = cfg.roarHold != null ? cfg.roarHold : 1.4;

const rigT = oni.rig.timing ? oni.rig.timing("roar", { hold: HOLD }) : null;

const PEAK = (rigT && rigT.peakMs) || cfg.peakMs || 1100; // the jaw snap (full gape)

const ROAR_END = (rigT && rigT.durationMs) || (PEAK + (HOLD + 1.1) * 1000);

const CHARGE0 = cfg.chargeMs != null ? cfg.chargeMs : 250;

// the launch: the roar comes out of his mouth (the jaw is opening, 0.8 -> 1.1 s; the roar sound is up)

const LAUNCH = cfg.launchMs || 950;

const DROP = cfg.dropMs != null ? cfg.dropMs : 60; // mouth burst -> the ring starts on the floor under it

const WAVE0 = LAUNCH + DROP;

const TW = cfg.travelMs || 400; // ring start -> the front reaches the farthest target

setWash(g.tok, 0.72 * Math.max(kIn, st >= 0 ? 0.6 : 0) * kOut, 1.15);

}

const ck = Math.max(0, 1 - Math.abs(el - LAUNCH - 150) / 600);

setWash(caster, 0.38 * sine(ck), 1.25);

// dim the scene a little so the green reads on the bright valley floor

dimK = DIM * sine(seg(el, 0, 600)) * (1 - sine(seg(el, GATE + 300, GATE + 1100)));

const scr = screenRectE();

dimG.clear(); if (dimK > 0.005) { dimG.beginFill(0x020a06, dimK).drawRect(scr.x0 - (scr.x1 - scr.x0), scr.y0 - (scr.y1 - scr.y0), (scr.x1 - scr.x0) * 3, (scr.y1 - scr.y0) * 3).endFill(); }

if (!FX) return;

// pixels at 30 fps

if (lastSim >= 0 && el - lastSim < 33) return;

const dt = lastSim < 0 ? 1 / 30 : Math.min(0.1, (el - lastSim) / 1000); lastSim = el;

// the charge: soul fire gathers in his mouth as the roar winds up; the ring runs from WAVE0

const MO = mouthE(el), dirX = (TG.length ? TG.reduce((a, g) => a + g.f.x, 0) / TG.length : C2.x + 1) >= C2.x ? 1 : -1;

if (el >= CHARGE0 && el < LAUNCH) {

const u = seg(el, CHARGE0, LAUNCH);

for (let i = 0; i < 2 + Math.round(4 * u); i++) { const a = rr(0, Math.PI * 2), d = rr(18, 46) * MO.m * D, T = rr(0.12, 0.22); puffs.f.push({ kind: "puff", x: MO.x + Math.cos(a) * d, y: MO.y + Math.sin(a) * d, vx: -Math.cos(a) * d / T, vy: -Math.sin(a) * d / T, age: 0, life: T, s: rr(1.6, 3) * MO.m * D * (0.6 + 0.6 * u), f: R() }); }

mouthGlow = { x: MO.x, y: MO.y, r: (20 + 40 * u) * MO.m * D, k: 0.15 + 0.35 * u };

} else mouthGlow = null;

let r = 0, k = 0;

if (el >= WAVE0) { r = radiusAt(el); k = 1 - sine(seg(el, WAVE0 + TW, WAVE0 + TW + FADE_MS)); }

const WB = (28 + 18 * seg(el, WAVE0, WAVE0 + 200)) * (0.6 + 0.4 * k);

const S = ringSamples(r, k, tSec, scr, WB);

// the flow: soul-fire puffs and sparks off the front (rate per sample)

const rate = (cfg.puffRate || 0.3) * k;

const vr = el < WAVE0 ? 0 : (radiusAt(el + 20) - radiusAt(el - 20)) / 0.04; // the front's speed, floor px/s

for (const L of ["b", "f"]) for (const s of S[L]) {

if (!s.vis) continue;

const ride = vr * s.sc * 0.55;

if (R() < rate * s.e) spawnPuff(L, s.fx + rr(-2, 2), s.fy + rr(-2, 2), s.m, k, 1.1, s.ux * ride * 0.6, s.uy * ride * 0.6);

if (R() < rate * 0.05 * s.e) spawnSpark(L, s.fx, s.fy - 3, s.m);

}

// the launch: the roar bursts out of his mouth (a spray of soul fire forward and down to the floor, shock

// rings off the mouth, a flash), and the ring starts on the floor under it

if (!shook && el >= LAUNCH) {

shook = true;

try { oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs || 800, intensity: cfg.shake || 9 }); } catch (e) {}

const FL = proj(C2.x, C2.y), floorDy = Math.max(30, FL.y * D - MO.y);

for (let i = 0; i < 60; i++) {

const a = rr(-0.35, 1.2), sp = rr(250, 700) * MO.m * D; // forward (toward the party) and down

spawnPuff("f", MO.x + rr(-6, 6), MO.y + rr(-6, 6), MO.m, 1, 0.4, dirX * Math.cos(a) * sp, Math.sin(a) * sp * (floorDy / 220), 1.25);

}

for (let i = 0; i < 24; i++) spawnSpark("f", MO.x + rr(-10, 10), MO.y + rr(-10, 10), MO.m);

flashes.push({ L: "f", x: MO.x, y: MO.y, r: 150 * MO.m * D, at: el, dur: 450, k: 0.7 });

for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) shocks.push({ at: el + j * 70, x: MO.x, y: MO.y, m: MO.m });

}

// a target the front reaches: soul fire licks up round its feet, a flash at its chest

for (const g of TG) {

if (el < g.at || g.done > 2) continue;

const bb = bodyBox(g.tok), fx = (bb.x0 + bb.w / 2) * D, fy = (bb.y0 + bb.h) * D, m = proj(g.f.x, g.f.y).m;

if (!g.done) {

g.done = 1;

try { oni.hit({ tokenUuid: g.tok.document.uuid, hit: g.hit }); } catch (e) {}

if (g.hit) {

flashes.push({ L: "f", x: fx, y: fy - bb.h * 0.45 * D, r: Math.max(40, bb.w * 0.6) * D, at: el, dur: 380, k: 0.5 });

if (!firstHit) { firstHit = true; try { oni.screenshake({ duration: 260, intensity: 4 }); } catch (e) {} }

}

}

if (!g.hit) { g.done = 3; continue; }

const u = (el - g.at) / 320;

if (u > 1) { g.done = 3; continue; }

const n = Math.round(9 * (1 - u));

for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) { const a = rr(0, Math.PI * 2); spawnPuff("f", fx + Math.cos(a) * bb.w * 0.34 * D, fy + Math.sin(a) * 6 * m * D, m, 1, 2.2, 0, 0, 1.25); }

if (R() < 0.6) spawnSpark("f", fx + rr(-0.3, 0.3) * bb.w * D, fy - rr(0, 0.6) * bb.h * D, m);

}

step(puffs.b, dt); step(puffs.f, dt); step(sparks.b, dt); step(sparks.f, dt);

for (let i = flashes.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (el - flashes[i].at > flashes[i].dur) flashes.splice(i, 1);

for (let i = shocks.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) if (el - shocks[i].at > 280) shocks.splice(i, 1);

for (const L of ["b", "f"]) {

const items = [], lights = [];

bandItems(S[L], k, items, lights);

if (L === "f") {

if (mouthGlow) lights.push({ x: mouthGlow.x, y: mouthGlow.y, r: mouthGlow.r, c: GLOW, k: mouthGlow.k });

for (const q of shocks) shockItem(q, el, items);

}

for (const q of flashes) if (q.L === L) { const a = 1 - (el - q.at) / q.dur; lights.push({ x: q.x, y: q.y, r: q.r, c: GLOW, k: q.k * a * a }, { x: q.x, y: q.y, r: q.r * 0.35, c: PX.WHITE, k: 0.25 * a * a }); }

(L === "b" ? LB : LF).draw(items, puffs[L], sparks[L], lights, tSec);

}

}

// ── run ──

const SFX = cfg.sfx || [];

const roar = oni.rig.roar(caster, { hold: HOLD });

t0 = performance.now();

ready();

for (const c of SFX) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.7, delay: c.at || 0 }); } catch (e) {} }

const tkr = canvas.app.ticker;

tickFn = () => { try { tick(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Call of the Master] frame threw", e); } };

tkr.add(tickFn);

const flashT = setTimeout(() => { try { oni.domFlash({ color: "#7dff8a", alpha: cfg.flashAlpha != null ? cfg.flashAlpha : 0.16, fadeIn: 60, hold: 40, fadeOut: 420 }); } catch (e) {} }, LAUNCH);

try {

await wait(GATE);

gate();

await wait(Math.max(0, TOTAL - GATE));

try { await Promise.race([roar.done, wait(1500)]); } catch (e) {}

} finally {

clearTimeout(flashT);

try { tkr.remove(tickFn); } catch (e) {}

for (const g of TG) { try { if (g.tok.mesh) g.tok.mesh.pivot.x = 0; } catch (e) {} }

dropWashes();

LB.destroy(); LF.destroy();

try { backRoot.parent && backRoot.parent.removeChild(backRoot); backRoot.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

try { frontRoot.parent && frontRoot.parent.removeChild(frontRoot); frontRoot.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

gate();

}

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 15000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, hits: hitMap(), strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Call of the Master" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

props.animation_script:
// Soul Devour — generated by tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js

// Re-run: node tools/anim-studio/lib/nidhogg-signatures.js --out <file>

(async () => {

const CFG = {"swallowMs":2500,"glintMs":800,"totalMs":3800,"gateLagMs":0,"jaw":30,"head":10,"thrust":-6,"shake":4,"moteMax":1800,"airN":64,"glowPtsMax":1600,"surgeBand":0.16,"prepareMs":200,"suppressMaxMs":8000,"totalTimeoutMs":15000,"sfx":[{"at":80,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Monster2.ogg","v":0.35},{"at":250,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Wind1.ogg","v":0.5,"fadeAfter":1900,"fadeMs":400},{"at":300,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Absorb1.ogg","v":0.4},{"at":550,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Condition_Burn.ogg","v":0.3,"fadeAfter":1500,"fadeMs":400},{"at":700,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Darkness4.ogg","v":0.5},{"at":2380,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Eating.mp3","v":0.55},{"at":2500,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/SE_BTL_HitFire.ogg","v":0.35},{"at":2550,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Powerup.ogg","v":0.55},{"at":2420,"url":"https://assets.forge-vtt.com/610d918102e7ac281373ffcb/Sound/Soundboard/Fire2.ogg","v":0.3}]};

const ANIM_KEY = "oni.nidhogg.soul-devour";

const TAG = "[ONI][Anim][Soul Devour]";

const P = globalThis.__PAYLOAD ?? payload ?? {};

function tokFromUuid(u) { try { const d = fromUuidSync?.(u); return d?.object ?? null; } catch (_) { return null; } }

function resolveSource() {

for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

return canvas?.tokens?.controlled?.[0] ?? null;

}

function resolveTargets() {

const out = [];

const arg = Array.isArray(targets) ? targets : [];

for (const t of arg) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

if (!out.length && Array.isArray(globalThis.__TARGETS)) for (const t of globalThis.__TARGETS) if (t?.center) out.push(t);

return out;

}

function hitMap() {

try {

const d = globalThis.FUCompanion?.api?.experimental?.battleDirector?.getActiveDirector?.();

const r = d?.ctx?.actionResult?.perTargetResults;

if (!Array.isArray(r) || !r.length) return null;

const o = {};

for (const x of r) if (x?.tokenUuid) o[x.tokenUuid] = x.hit !== false;

return o;

} catch (_) { return null; }

}

const sourceToken = resolveSource();

const partyTargets = resolveTargets();

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

function onceHook(hookName, timeoutMs) {

return new Promise((resolve) => {

let settled = false;

const timer = setTimeout(() => { if (settled) return; settled = true; Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve({ ok: false, timeout: true }); }, timeoutMs);

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

Hooks.on(hookName, h);

});

}

function emitLocal(n, d) { try { Hooks.callAll(n, d); } catch (_) {} }

const scriptSource = String.raw`

// Soul Devour · Nidhogg (inner script, every client). Port of the mockup's option B "Inhale"

// (tools/nidhogg-soul-devour-mockup/fx/option-b.js + devour-common.js), in soul GREEN.

// He opens his jaws wide and breathes in (his rig's inhale motion). Green streaks of air spiral into his mouth

// round a slow vortex and the target Soul Fragment's own fire is blown toward him. The fragment comes apart from the

// side facing him (a ragged white front) into motes that lift like ash and spiral into his mouth, heating as they go.

// SWALLOW (the rig's peak): his jaw snaps shut, a flash and a ring of puffs at his mouth, a short shake; the light

// runs back through his glowing parts (the surge, embers lifting off it). The fragment's core, left behind as one

// bright mote, becomes a glint that arcs home to its owner; it lands (the owner crackles): the damage gate.

// Pieces: the fragment's body, fire and ash are ONE small frame in the fragment's own space (made from its

// silhouette, fieldSil), shown at its depth and scaled with the camera; the motes, air, swallow, surge, embers and

// glint are on CotM's on-demand tile layer in screen space; big soft lights are GPU sprites. Everything is placed in

// the renderer's prerender, after the 3D camera has posed, and its pixels step at the user's effects frame rate.

// The engine's destroy row runs with show=none: this show owns the dissolve and the glint home. The fragment's own

// idle fire and mesh are handed to us by soul-fx-runtime's suppressFragmentFire(id, { hideMesh: true }); on the

// success path it is NOT restored (the destroy deletes the token after the gate; the hook's timer covers a

// survivor). Only a show that aborts before the dissolve restores it. Every sound goes through oni.sfx.

// No backticks in this file.

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const frag = (ctx.targetTokens || []).find((t) => t && !t.destroyed && t.mesh) || null;

const readyHook = ctx.params.readyHook;

const ready = () => { if (readyHook) { try { Hooks.callAll(readyHook); } catch (e) {} } };

let gated = false;

const gate = () => { if (gated) return; gated = true; oni.fireDone(); };

if (!caster || !caster.mesh || !canvas || !canvas.ready) { ready(); gate(); return; }

const TAG = "[ONI][Soul Devour]";

const route = (p) => { try { return foundry.utils.getRoute(p); } catch (e) { return "/" + p; } };

const MOD = "modules/fabula-ultima-companion/scripts/";

let PX = null, SL = null, FIRE = null, NA = null, NR = null, SFR = null, CO = null;

try {

PX = await import(route(MOD + "battle-director/pixel-entrance/pixelfx/core/index.js"));

SL = await import(route(MOD + "conflict-event/soul-fx/soul-fx-lib.js"));

FIRE = await import(route(MOD + "battle-director/pixel-entrance/pixelfx/fx/fire/_lib.js"));

} catch (e) { console.warn(TAG, "pixel fx unavailable", e); PX = null; SL = null; }

try {

NA = await import(route(MOD + "sealing-crystal/nidhogg-awakening.js"));

NR = await import(route(MOD + "battle-director/battle-stage-3d-rules.js"));

} catch (e) { console.warn(TAG, "shot solver unavailable", e); }

// the SAME module instance the runtime uses (same URL): its fieldSil and the fragment fire hook

try { SFR = await import(route(MOD + "conflict-event/soul-fx/soul-fx-runtime.js")); } catch (e) { console.warn(TAG, "soul-fx runtime unavailable", e); }

try { CO = await import(route(MOD + "shared/client-options.js")); } catch (e) {}

// a real clock for the cost readout (performance.now may be a virtual clock under the recorder; marks are not)

const realNow = () => { try { const m = performance.mark("oni-sd"); performance.clearMarks("oni-sd"); return m.startTime; } catch (e) { return performance.now(); } };

const FX = !!(PX && SL);

// the user's "Effects frame rate" (60 or 30): every pixel layer steps at it

let FX_HZ = 60;

try { FX_HZ = Number(CO.getClientOption("fxFrameRate")) === 30 ? 30 : 60; } catch (e) { FX_HZ = 60; }

if (cfg.fxHz === 30 || cfg.fxHz === 60) FX_HZ = cfg.fxHz;

const STEP_MS = 1000 / FX_HZ;

// ── timing (s from the start; the mockup's beats, the swallow on the rig's peak) ──

const RIG_OPTS = { swallow: (cfg.swallowMs || 2500) / 1000, jaw: cfg.jaw != null ? cfg.jaw : 30, head: cfg.head != null ? cfg.head : 10, thrust: cfg.thrust != null ? cfg.thrust : -6 };

const rigT = oni.rig.timing ? oni.rig.timing("inhale", RIG_OPTS) : null;

const IN = ((rigT && rigT.peakMs) || RIG_OPTS.swallow * 1000) / 1000;

const RIG_END = (rigT && rigT.durationMs) || Math.round((IN + 0.12 + 0.9) * 1000);

const T = { GAPE: 0.1, BREATHE: 0.3, START: 0.5, SWEEP: 0.9, IN, SURGE: IN + 0.05, GLINT: IN + 0.12, END: (cfg.totalMs || 3800) / 1000 };

const GLINT_T = (cfg.glintMs || 800) / 1000;

const LAND = T.GLINT + GLINT_T; // the glint lands on its owner

const GATE_MS = Math.round(LAND * 1000) + (cfg.gateLagMs || 0);

const TOTAL = Math.max(Math.round(T.END * 1000), RIG_END + 50, GATE_MS + 100);

const SQ = 0.55; // the floor squash of every spiral

// ── space (WB's helpers) ──

const S3 = () => globalThis.__ONI_BATTLE_STAGE_3D__ || null;

let D = 1;

try { const v = globalThis.FUCompanion.api.camera.restViewFor(canvas.scene); if (v && v.scale > 0) D = v.scale; } catch (e) {}

if (!(D > 0)) D = canvas.stage.scale.x || 1;

const rect2D = (tok) => {

try {

const r = tok.mesh.getBounds(false);

if (!r || !(r.width > 0)) throw new Error("no bounds");

const wt = canvas.stage.worldTransform;

const a = wt.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(r.x, r.y)), b = wt.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(r.x + r.width, r.y + r.height));

return { x: Math.min(a.x, b.x), y: Math.min(a.y, b.y), w: Math.abs(b.x - a.x), h: Math.abs(b.y - a.y) };

} catch (e) { return { x: tok.document.x, y: tok.document.y, w: tok.w, h: tok.h }; }

};

// read once, outside any render (inside one the camera has moved the meshes to their drawn spots)

const CR = rect2D(caster);

const CF = { x: caster.document.x + caster.w / 2, y: caster.document.y + caster.h };

const MIRROR = (Number(caster.document.texture.scaleX) || 1) < 0;

const mapOf = (tok) => { try { const s = S3(); const m = s && s.drawnMap && tok && !tok.destroyed ? s.drawnMap(tok) : null; return m && Number.isFinite(m.fx) ? m : null; } catch (e) { return null; } };

const foot2d = (tok) => { const m = mapOf(tok); return m ? { x: m.fx, y: m.fy } : { x: tok.document.x + tok.w / 2, y: tok.document.y + tok.h }; };

// a 2D point placed against a token's spot -> effect px where it is drawn now (+ its drawn scale)

const mapE = (tok, p) => { const m = mapOf(tok); return m ? { x: (m.bx + (p.x - m.fx) * m.m) * D, y: (m.by + (p.y - m.fy) * m.m) * D, m: m.m } : { x: p.x * D, y: p.y * D, m: 1 }; };

// and back: the 2D point of an effect-px spot drawn now

const unmapE = (tok, e) => { const m = mapOf(tok), wx = e[0] / D, wy = e[1] / D; return m ? { x: m.fx + (wx - m.bx) / m.m, y: m.fy + (wy - m.by) / m.m, m: m.m } : { x: wx, y: wy, m: 1 }; };

const screenRectE = () => {

const r = canvas.app.renderer, W = r.screen.width, H = r.screen.height;

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(0, 0), b = inv(W, H);

return { x0: a.x * D, y0: a.y * D, x1: b.x * D, y1: b.y * D };

};

// the TokenMagic float this frame (effect px, + = down); read on the ticker, outside the render (soul-fx-runtime floatDy)

const floatDyE = (tok) => {

try {

const mesh = tok && !tok.destroyed ? tok.mesh : null, fs = mesh && mesh.filters;

if (!fs || !fs.length) return 0;

let t = 0, pad = 0;

for (const f of fs) { const ty = Number(f && f.translationY); if (!f || !f.filterId || !Number.isFinite(ty) || ty === 0) continue; t += ty; pad = Math.max(pad, Number(f.padding) || 0); }

if (!t) return 0;

const m = mapOf(tok);

return Math.round(-t * (Math.abs(mesh.height) + 2 * pad) * (m ? m.m : 1) * D);

} catch (e) { return 0; }

};

// ── his mouth: a point on the painting carried by the rig's live pose (rig.json jaw / neck pivots) ──

const ART = cfg.art || { w: 859, h: 837, mouth: [112, 532], jaw: [193, 503], neck: [262, 468], eye: [158, 477] };

const D2R = Math.PI / 180;

// INHALE-CURVE-BEGIN (a copy of rig-motions.js "inhale" sample(); tools/anim-studio/test/soul-devour-inhale.test.mjs

// asserts it equals the rig's own curve: change both together)

const inhaleCurve = (t, o) => {

o = o || {};

const es = (x) => (x <= 0 ? 0 : x >= 1 ? 1 : x * x * (3 - 2 * x));

const S = o.swallow != null ? o.swallow : 2.5, J = o.jaw != null ? o.jaw : 30, HD = o.head != null ? o.head : 10, TH = o.thrust != null ? o.thrust : -6;

const t2 = S + 0.12, t3 = t2 + 0.9;

let jaw, lift, breath, wings;

if (t < 0.1) { jaw = 0; lift = 0; breath = 0; wings = 0; }

else if (t < 0.3) { const e = es((t - 0.1) / 0.2); jaw = 8 * e; lift = 3 * e; breath = 0.4 * e; wings = 0; }

else if (t < S) {

const u = Math.min(1, (t - 0.3) / Math.max(0.01, S - 0.3)), e = es(u);

props.description:
Nidhogg devours one of his Soul Fragments. It is destroyed, and he recovers 【twice its Max HP】 Mind Points.

The soul it held goes back to its owner without healing them: their Max HP is restored, but their current HP is not.
props.name: Soul Devour

props.description:
When a player character is reduced to 0 HP and is not saved by an effect that revives them at once, Nidhogg gains 1 Zero Power. That player is revived at full HP as a Nox Servant for the rest of the battle. Once per player.

A Nox Servant cannot be targeted by opponents, cannot take part in a Massive action, and cannot drop below 1 HP. Their Soul Fragment stays on the battlefield for good.

• Overflow

Nidhogg sings a requiem for the living, and soul-poison seeps through the whole battlefield. All enemies must each make a DL 16 【MIG + WLP】 Check. Each creature that fails is left Poisoned and Envenomed.

This spell costs 100 MP and makes no accuracy check.

if (!(D > 0)) D = canvas.stage.scale.x || 1;

// a token's drawn body box in world px

const bodyBox = (tok) => {

try {

const s = S3(); const b = s && s.drawnMeshBounds ? s.drawnMeshBounds(tok) : tok.mesh.getBounds(false);

if (b && b.width > 0) {

const inv = (x, y) => canvas.stage.worldTransform.applyInverse(new PIXI.Point(x, y));

const a = inv(b.x, b.y), c = inv(b.x + b.width, b.y + b.height);

return { x0: a.x, y0: a.y, w: c.x - a.x, h: c.y - a.y };

}

} catch (e) {}

return { x0: tok.x, y0: tok.y, w: tok.w, h: tok.h };

};

// ── layer: one frame per hit target (colour + additive light sprite), effect px = screen px x K ──

const root = new PIXI.Container(); root.name = "oni-nidhogg-claw"; root.eventMode = "none"; root.scale.set(1 / D); root.zIndex = 95000;

canvas.stage.sortableChildren = true; canvas.stage.addChild(root);

// his soul ramp (soul-fx-lib SOUL): the mark's core white-hot, cooling through soul green to a dark green burn

const PAL = cfg.palette || ["#03140b", "#0a3019", "#11522a", "#1d7d3b", "#34b04d", "#5dff6e", "#b4ffba", "#ffffff"];

const SPK = cfg.sparks || ["#dcffd2", "#a6ff9c", "#5dff6e", "#22a86c"];

const GLOW_TINT = 0x5dff6e;

const FW = 150, FH = 124, OX = 40, OY = 100; // frame size and the effect's origin in it

const MX = 30, MY = -21, MH = 34; // the marks' centre (from the origin) and their height, effect px

const bufTex = (buf) => PIXI.Texture.fromBuffer(new Uint8Array(buf.buffer, buf.byteOffset, FW * FH * 4), FW, FH, { scaleMode: PIXI.SCALE_MODES.NEAREST, alphaMode: PIXI.ALPHA_MODES.UNPACK });

// the soft bloom: one radial texture for the run, drawn additive and tinted green over each target's marks

let bloomTex = null;

const getBloomTex = () => {

if (bloomTex) return bloomTex;

const cv = document.createElement("canvas"); cv.width = cv.height = 128;

const c2 = cv.getContext("2d"), gr = c2.createRadialGradient(64, 64, 0, 64, 64, 64);

gr.addColorStop(0, "rgba(255,255,255,1)"); gr.addColorStop(0.35, "rgba(255,255,255,0.45)"); gr.addColorStop(1, "rgba(255,255,255,0)");

c2.fillStyle = gr; c2.fillRect(0, 0, 128, 128);

return (bloomTex = PIXI.Texture.from(cv));

};

// the marks as the stock effect draws them (claw-swipe.js: through(31 + 8i, -23 + 2i, 1.84, 1, 40, 0.84 - 0.05i, 0.5),

// width 4.2 - 0.4i, opening at 0.04i s): where each mark's soul flame burns, in frame px

const MARKS = [0, 1, 2].map((i) => {

const s = LIB ? LIB.through(31 + i * 8, -23 + i * 2, 1.84, 1, 40, 0.84 - i * 0.05, 0.5) : null, W = 4.2 - i * 0.4;

const pts = [];

if (s) for (let k = 0; k <= 8; k++) { const q = LIB.onSwing(s, s.R - W / 2, s.span * (0.12 + 0.76 * k / 8)); pts.push([OX + q[0], OY + q[1]]); }

return { open: i * 0.04 + 0.035, pts };

});

let seedR = 0x2545F491;

const R = () => { seedR ^= seedR << 13; seedR ^= seedR >>> 17; seedR ^= seedR << 5; return ((seedR >>> 0) % 100000) / 100000; };

const rr = (a, b) => a + (b - a) * R();

// a soul-flame puff (CotM's): rises and slows; puffField merges them, hottest where they are young and dense

const spawnPuff = (L, x, y, k) => L.push({ kind: "puff", x, y, vx: rr(-6, 6), vy: -rr(18, 42), age: 0, life: rr(0.16, 0.3) * (0.7 + 0.4 * k), s: rr(1.3, 2.3) * (0.6 + 0.5 * k), f: R() });

const stepPuffs = (L, dt) => { for (let i = L.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) { const q = L[i]; q.age += dt; if (q.age >= q.life) { L.splice(i, 1); continue; } q.x += q.vx * dt; q.y += q.vy * dt; q.vx *= Math.pow(0.2, dt); q.vy *= Math.pow(0.55, dt); } };

// how hard a mark still burns u s into the effect: full as it tears open, then dying over LINGER

const burnK = (u, open) => { const v = u - open; return v < 0 ? 0 : v < 0.1 ? 1 : Math.max(0, 1 - (v - 0.1) / LINGER); };

function makeFx(g) {

const frame = PX.createFrame(FW, FH);

const fx = PX.createFx(FXM, { x: OX, y: OY, palette: PAL, sparks: SPK, seed: 8 + g.i * 5, light: cfg.lightK || 1.3 });

const cs = new PIXI.Sprite(bufTex(frame.color)), ls = new PIXI.Sprite(bufTex(frame.light));

ls.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

const bl = new PIXI.Sprite(getBloomTex()); bl.anchor.set(0.5); bl.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; bl.tint = GLOW_TINT; bl.alpha = 0;

root.addChild(bl, cs, ls);

const bb = bodyBox(g.tok);

const K = Math.max(2, Math.min(4, Math.round((bb.h * D * (cfg.markScale || 0.7)) / MH)));

return { frame, fx, cs, ls, bl, K, last: 0, puffs: [], fxDone: false };

}

function placeFx(g) {

const bb = bodyBox(g.tok), F = g.fx, K = F.K;

const cx = (bb.x0 + bb.w / 2) * D, cy = (bb.y0 + bb.h * 0.42) * D;

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { s.scale.set(K); s.position.set(Math.round(cx - (OX + MX) * K), Math.round(cy - (OY + MY) * K)); }

F.bl.position.set(cx, cy); F.bl.scale.set((MH * K * (cfg.bloomSize || 2.4)) / 128);

}

function dropFx(g) {

const F = g.fx; if (!F) return;

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { try { s.parent && s.parent.removeChild(s); s.destroy({ texture: true, baseTexture: true }); } catch (e) {} }

try { F.bl.parent && F.bl.parent.removeChild(F.bl); F.bl.destroy({ texture: false }); } catch (e) {}

g.fx = null;

}

// ── the show ──

let t0 = 0, lastSim = -1, tickFn = null, nHit = 0;

const cost = { n: 0, sum: 0, max: 0 };

function tick() {

const c0 = performance.now(), el = c0 - t0;

// the damage beat per target, on every client (the presenter listens for oni:hit)

for (const g of TG) {

if (g.done || el < g.hitAt) continue;

g.done = true;

try { oni.hit({ tokenUuid: g.tok.document.uuid, hit: g.hit }); } catch (e) {}

if (g.hit) { nHit++; try { oni.screenshake({ duration: nHit === 1 ? 240 : 200, intensity: nHit === 1 ? 6 : 4 }); } catch (e) {} }

}

if (!PX || !FXM) return;

// pixels at 30 fps

if (lastSim >= 0 && el - lastSim < 33) return;

lastSim = el;

for (const g of TG) {

if (!g.hit || el < g.fxAt) continue;

if (!g.fx && !g.gone) { try { g.fx = makeFx(g); } catch (e) { g.gone = true; console.warn("[ONI][Claw] fx build failed", e); continue; } }

const F = g.fx; if (!F) continue;

const u = Math.min((el - g.fxAt) / 1000, FLAME_END / 1000 + 0.2), dts = Math.max(0, u - F.last);

if (dts > 0) { if (!F.fxDone) F.fx.update(dts); F.last = u; }

if (!F.fxDone && F.fx.done()) F.fxDone = true;

// the soul flame left burning on the marks: front-loaded as each tears open, dying over LINGER

let burning = 0;

for (const m of MARKS) {

const k = burnK(u, m.open); if (k <= 0) continue;

burning++;

const n = (u - m.open < 0.1 ? 2.0 : 1.1 * Math.pow(k, 1.4)) * (cfg.flameRate || 1);

for (let j = 0; j < 3; j++) if (R() < n / 3) { const q = m.pts[Math.floor(R() * m.pts.length)]; if (q) spawnPuff(F.puffs, q[0] + rr(-1, 1), q[1] + rr(-1, 1), k); }

}

stepPuffs(F.puffs, dts);

if (F.fxDone && !burning && !F.puffs.length) { dropFx(g); g.gone = true; continue; }

PX.clearFrame(F.frame);

if (!F.fxDone) F.fx.draw(F.frame, "front");

if (SL && F.puffs.length) SL.puffField(PX.painterFor(F.frame), F.puffs, u);

// the bloom: flares green as the marks land, then breathes down with the flame

const hitU = MARK_HIT / 1000, flare = u < hitU ? Math.max(0, (u - 0.02) / (hitU - 0.02)) : Math.exp(-(u - hitU) / 0.18);

F.bl.alpha = (cfg.bloomAlpha || 0.5) * Math.max(flare, 0.35 * burnK(u, MARKS[2].open));

for (const s of [F.cs, F.ls]) { try { s.texture.baseTexture.resource.update(); } catch (e) {} }

placeFx(g);

}

const dt = performance.now() - c0; cost.n++; cost.sum += dt; if (dt > cost.max) cost.max = dt;

if (cfg.debug) globalThis.__nidCost = { avg: +(cost.sum / cost.n).toFixed(3), max: +cost.max.toFixed(3), n: cost.n };

}

// ── run ──

const rig = oni.rig.play(caster, "clawSwipe", {});

t0 = performance.now();

ready();

for (const c of cfg.sfx || []) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.6, delay: c.at || 0 }); } catch (e) {} }

for (const g of TG) {

if (!g.hit) continue;

for (const c of cfg.hitSfx || []) { try { oni.sfx(c.url, { volume: c.v != null ? c.v : 0.6, delay: Math.max(0, g.hitAt + (c.dt || 0)) }); } catch (e) {} }

}

const tkr = canvas.app.ticker;

tickFn = () => { try { tick(); } catch (e) { console.warn("[ONI][Claw] frame threw", e); } };

tkr.add(tickFn);

try {

await wait(GATE);

tick();

gate();

await wait(Math.max(0, TOTAL - GATE));

try { await Promise.race([rig.done, wait(800)]); } catch (e) {}

} finally {

try { tkr.remove(tickFn); } catch (e) {}

for (const g of TG) dropFx(g);

try { root.parent && root.parent.removeChild(root); root.destroy({ children: true }); } catch (e) {}

gate();

}

`;

try {

const waitReady = onceHook(readyHook, 8000);

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 10000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, hits: hitMap(), strikes: Array.isArray(P?.strikes) ? P.strikes : [] },

meta: { source: "Claw" },

});

await waitReady;

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

props.zero_trigger_description:
Nox Servant. When a player character is reduced to 0 HP and is not saved by an effect that revives them at once, Nidhogg gains 1 Zero Power. That player is revived at full HP as a Nox Servant: opponents cannot target them, they cannot take part in a Massive action, and they cannot drop below 1 HP. Their Soul Fragment stays on the battlefield for the rest of the battle.

Oath of Servitude. At the moment every player character is a Nox Servant, the battle enters the Crystal Round until the end of the battle. The Crystal gains half of the dragon's remaining HP. At the end of each round Nidhogg gains 1 Zero Power.
